text:
Support Bot: alert posted: multiple customers reporting 5xx + auth billing failures and p95 latency spike in us-west-2 between 02:10-02:18 UTC :rotating_light:
Priya (support): seeing 8 different tickets, one customer provided curl repro. errors are 502/504 and repeated 499s from our gateway.
Jamal (eng-runtime): can you drop the repro curl here? also which model/endpoint?
Priya (support): customer used hosted/v1/generate with model "redwood-2-large". repro: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":512}'
```
responses: 502 or connection reset after ~10s.
Mike (eng-infra): telemetry shows short-lived auth service latency bump and billing API 5xx around same window. KVS cache warmed then small spike in open conns.
Sarah (eng-oncall): I see gateway p95 latency from 180ms -> 2.3s and increased queueing on the hosted inference frontends at 02:12. Correlates with token-gen rate from that tenant.
Jamal (eng-runtime): likely two compounding issues: authz calls timing out (we call billing to validate quotas) -> gateway waits -> runtime queues and trips 502.
Priya (support): customer claim: they hadn't increased usage. could be retry amplification from SDK. logged their request headers; they use default retry policy.
Jamal (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations: 1) temporary bypass billing check for that customer's requests for 10m via per-tenant feature-flag (safe mode). 2) lower per-req auth timeout to 500ms so we fail fast -> client sees 429/401 instead of blocking pipeline. 3) route heavy requests to dedicated pool if configured.
Mike (eng-infra): I'll push a quick feature-flag toggle to disable billing synchronous check for tenant 'acme-inc' in us-west-2. prepping PR: `infra/featureflags#273`
InfraBot: deploy queued: feature-flag toggle (kill switch) -> pending canary to 3 hosts -> will report status.
Priya (support): customer agreed to short maintenance window if we need to route.
Sarah (eng-oncall): Jamal/Mike, prioritize the kill switch. If canary looks good, roll to all frontends, then re-evaluate.
Mike (eng-infra): canary green on 3 hosts at 02:23. Rolling to 12 hosts now.
InfraBot: rollout complete at 02:29. Error rates for tenant drop to baseline.
Priya (support): Confirmed with customer: errors resolved after 02:30 window, tickets updated.
Jamal (eng-runtime): Next steps (action items):
- A1: Add an automated fallback path when billing API latency > 300ms (owner: Jamal) due EOD+2 (assign alert bucket).
- A2: Add tenant-level async billing validation (owner: Mike) due +1 week.
- A3: Audit SDK default retry policy and publish recommended config for bursty clients (owner: Priya) due +3 days.
- A4: Improve dashboard to link tenant->authz calls latency (owner: Sarah) due +4 days.
Priya (support): I'll add customer-facing comms template and notify support triage.
Mike (eng-infra): I'll create runbook snippet for toggling the billing-check kill switch and add it to the oncall playbook.
Jamal (eng-runtime): quick repro notes for postmortem:
- Repro steps we used: heavy single-tenant seq-len <=512, 200 rps sustained with default SDK retries -> auth calls spike -> sync validation amplifies tail.
- Debug commands: `kubectl logs -l service=auth-proxy -n hosted-usw2 --since=20m | grep tenant=acme-inc`
- Quick trace snippet: `trace_id=abcd1234` shows billing call 1.3s then runtime waiting 8s before gateway timed out.
Sarah (eng-oncall): Scheduling a 30m post-incident sync tomorrow 09:00 PT. Invite: @Jamal @Mike @Priya @support-leads.
Priya (support): I'll prepare ticket bundle: customer tickets + timeline + customer comm draft.
Jamal (eng-runtime): Longer-term engineering tasks (to capture in RFC): async billing validation, client-side retry guidance, contour-based circuit-breaker per-tenant.
Mike (eng-infra): I'll open infra ticket INFRA-482 to add tenant-level metrics for billing latency and a synthetic check that runs every 5m.
Priya (support): marking incident resolved for now. Will follow up in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
Sarah (eng-oncall): Nice work team. Add the action items to the incident tracker and assign owners.
Priya (support): done — tracker link: https://go/reports/INC-3288880000-summary (internal).
